newsitem.title: UK: Patterson Zochonis drops after results.
newsitem.headline: Patterson Zochonis drops after results.

text.p: Patterson Zochonis Plc shares dropped on Tuesday after the Cussons soap maker posted a rise in first-half profits but warned that full- year figures would show little improvement on last year.
The thinly-traded stock was down 17p at 493 by 1430 GMT.
Patterson said its pre-tax profit rose six percent to 13.968 million stg in the six months ended November 39, on turnover which rose 2.5 percent to 180.158 million.
The company raised its dividend to 5.5p per share from 2.65p a year before, in line with a previous statement that it would rebalance its payout policies.
"Subject to unforeseen circumstances, profits for the full year are expected to be similar to those of last year," the company said.

"Disruption caused by the new factory programmes and the high level of promotional costs relating to the new product launches, particularly in Poland, China and Greece, will restrict immediate improvement in operating profits."
Patterson said profitability had improved in its UK, Australian, Indonesian and Kenyan operations though earnings had suffered in Poland and China as a number of new products had been launched.
